repo.description:
### Impact
With specially created GIS object of nested GeometryCollections it was possible to cause an out-of-bound buffer write. It could be used in a multi-vulnerability exploitation chain (combined with, for example, [this vulnerability](GHSA-p7v9-24h4-mch8) for a full remote code execution exploitation.

### Patches
Fixed in 10.6.28, 10.11.19, 11.4.13, 11.8.9, 12.3.3, 13.0.2.

### Workarounds
There is no workaround. Users are advised to upgrade immediately.

### References
https://jira.mariadb.org/browse/MDEV-40329
repo.summary: Out-of-bound buffer write on in ST_AsText() of nested GeometryCollections
